headline: Eversource petition to install a pad mount transformer in front of 14 Barrington Dr. to provide solar to that house.
summary: The meeting will consider one petition from Eversource. It asks to install a pad mount transformer about 180 feet from Parker Street, in front of house #14 on Barrington Dr.
items: Petition from Eversource to install one pad mount transformer about 180 feet from Parker Street, in front of house #14 on Barrington Dr.
The transformer would provide solar to house 14 Barrington Dr. for the customer.

Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 4/22/2025 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can 
be acted upon at the meeting of the Board of Public Works Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 
3:30 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Location 
Front of 14 Barrington Dr. 
 
Petitions 
TO INSTALL (1) PAD MOUNT TRANSFORMER. THE TRANSFORMER IS TO BE 
LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 180' FROM PARKER STREET FRONT OF HOUSE #14 ON 
BARRINGTON DR. THIS TRANSFORMER WILL BE USED TO PROVIDE SOLAR TO 
HOUSE 14 BARRINGTON DR FOR THE CUSTOMER.  
 1. EVERSOURCE - Barrington Dr.
